note: This file is an MMDetection configuration file (dict of hyperparameters). It contains no callable functions, classes, or methods — only configuration data for training a knowledge distillation single-stage detector (LD with ResNet-18 student and GFL ResNet-101 teacher on COCO).
config_model_type: KnowledgeDistillationSingleStageDetector — LDHead with ResNet-18 student distilled from GFL ResNet-101 teacher
config_backbone: ResNet-18 backbone pretrained from torchvision, 4 stages, BatchNorm
config_neck: FPN neck with 256 output channels across 5 levels
config_head: LDHead with QualityFocalLoss, DistributionFocalLoss, KLDivLoss (T=10), and GIoULoss
config_training: SGD optimizer (lr=0.01, momentum=0.9), ATSSAssigner, 1x COCO schedule
